resolution.summary: Consumer-side change in tf2_tools/scripts/view_frames.py generate_dot: convert the decoded YAML key to a string before concatenation, "'\" -> \"'+str(el)+'\"'" (commit e4466f0, cherry-pick of PR #133's first commit beaeacb). The provider's YAML encoding (unquoted child key in BufferCore::allFramesAsYAML) is unchanged.

notes: Classification follows the code rather than the dataset summary: the summary calls this "a general Python problem" of dynamic typing, but the integer arises only because the provider writes the child frame id as an unquoted YAML mapping key ("mstream << frameIDs_reverse[cfid] << \": \" << std::endl;", tf2/src/buffer_core.cpp at 72fa6057) while quoting the parent ("  parent: '...'"), so a frame named "54" is decoded by the consumer's yaml.load as int 54 and the '+' concatenation with str raises; the parent value survives because it is quoted, which is why the fix wraps only el. The provider chain is tf2_ros.Buffer.__get_frames -> tf2_py BufferCore.all_frames_as_yaml -> tf2 BufferCore::allFramesAsYAML, all in the same repository snapshot; the unit is named tf2_ros because the consumer's interaction is the ~tf2_frames service that tf2_ros.Buffer advertises (view_frames creates the Buffer in its own process and calls the service on itself). PR #133 carried a second commit (3eb560f, "static_transform_publisher now throws an error when a not unitary quaternion is given in input", adding tf2::isUnitaryQuaternion) that was not merged ("The check for normalization needs to have some tolerance."; "normalization followed up in #196"); it concerns a different composition and is not a condition of this case. Confidence is medium because the exact revision the reporter ran is not stated and the crash text (traceback) is not quoted in the source; the mechanism is reconstructed from the code at the fix's parent revision.
